answer: Isomorphic Graph Topology Pruning flags Sybil clusters by analyzing post-trade interaction matrices. Every completed transaction acts as a directed edge connecting a buyer vertex to a seller wharf. The algorithm computes local clustering coefficients and cuts off accounts whose internal transaction density exceeds external trade by an order of magnitude. Stripped identities forfeit their accumulated crystal ledger balances directly to the protocol treasury, imposing a total loss of all operational liquidity deployed during the cluster's farming phase.
